connector_scope.meaning: Develop plain full-section timber overlaps and bolted solid-wood corner cleats, with factory brackets optional. Exclude half-laps, housed joinery, custom steel and structural wood-thread move interfaces. Require complete geometry, through-bolt/washer/nut stacks, mechanics, cost and evidence before selection or drilling.

frame_change_scope.clarified_question: May I change other hidden frame members as needed for a factory-connector design, while preserving the climbing surface and the 66 panel/kicker screw locations?
frame_change_scope.meaning: The earlier center-support-only preference no longer limits the separate bolted candidate. Preserve the selected baseline, climbing surface, panel outlines, and all 66 panel/kicker screw axes. Check actual kerf-right kicker edge support. The later V4 scope also permits full-section overlaps and solid timber cleats. This is design-scope permission, not acceptance of any joint, lumber change, calculation, purchase, or drilling schedule.
